title: [29x] Bug 652332 Issuing multiple Reminders or Finance Charge Memos with Print, produces a PDF only for the last one
summary: Fixed printing of multiple Reminders or Finance Charge Memos so all selected documents are included in the PDF output instead of only the last one.
key_points: Each issued document used to be printed separately, so every PDF overwrote the previous one
All issued documents are now sent to print in one call
Changes Issue Reminders and Issue Finance Charge Memos in the W1 and NO layers, plus Issue Reminders in BE
Tests added for printing several documents
quote: Batch all issued documents into a single print invocation so the generated PDF includes every selected Reminder or Finance Charge Memo.
